issues.title: Corrupted metric glyph rendering
issues.evidence: The percent symbol in '71%' has an overlapping, malformed glyph artifact.
issues.suggestion: Fix font rendering and character formatting for percentage values.
issues.triageNote: Source value is plain ASCII '71%' (byte-verified) rendered in IBM Plex Mono via font-code + tabular-nums; the eval agent's second VLM pass and an independent fresh VLM pass on qa/screenshots/pair-109.jpg both report crisp, normal monospace glyphs with no malformed/overlapping '%'; 4 of 6 StatTile pairs rendering the same font-face '%' and decimal values (pair-000, pair-097, pair-134, pair-149) passed with zero issues.

issues.title: Uneven bottom whitespace balance
issues.description: Tiles without sparklines present disproportionate empty space compared to the tile containing a chart.
issues.evidence: The rightmost latency tile includes a trend graph, leaving the other two metric tiles with empty bottom halves.
issues.suggestion: Standardize tile heights or provide consistent bottom auxiliary content across sibling tiles.
issues.triageNote: The pair-098 page (off-limits) grid-stretches one sparkline tile beside two plain tiles; the component already standardizes heights (VLM verified all three boxes share identical top/bottom edges — grid stretch) and top-aligns content per its documented shared-value-baseline design (meta.ts), so the residual space is inherent to the page's mixed sparkline/non-sparkline composition; the identical mixed composition passed with zero issues in pair-149 and is the demo's canonical layout. Post-fix re-audit of pair-098 now passes overall.

issues.title: Irregular number kerning
issues.evidence: Noticeable gap around the decimal point in '12 . 4k'.
issues.suggestion: Remove unnecessary spaces around the decimal point.
issues.triageNote: Byte-level dump of the pair-109 source shows value is '12.4k' with no space characters; the perceived gap is the normal full monospace cell of IBM Plex Mono's '.' under font-code/tabular-nums, confirmed as normal kerning with no blank spaces by an independent VLM pass on the screenshot.
